date.basis: component of own row; not dated itself

notes: Own-row cisterns have no direction (position none). SWP Mem II p. 156 no. 14 Yasid gives no pool, pit or grave. The same packet text also holds other entries (no. 15 Ez Zawieh with a well west of that hamlet; 'Anebta with rock-cut tombs and a tank; Beit Imrin with a spring): these are different places, not the unit, with no distance to it given; ignored. The Stage 1b 'tank' word comes from the 'Anebta entry, not Yasid.
